lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，那边的草长得高。
lines.en: I walk along the wall where the grass grows tall.

lines.zh: 这片地软，蹄子踩下去会陷。
lines.en: The ground is soft and my hooves sink in.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，反正也没人赶我。
lines.en: I go slowly; nobody is driving me anyway.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边嚼，嘴没停过。
lines.en: I chew as I walk, and my mouth never stops.

lines.zh: 风从那边来，带着青草味。
lines.en: The wind comes from over there, smelling of green grass.

lines.zh: 我绕开那滩黏的东西，它不好闻。
lines.en: I go around that sticky puddle; it smells wrong.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩着赶不走什么，就是习惯。
lines.en: My tail swishes at nothing, out of habit.

lines.zh: 我跟着同伴走，它去哪我去哪。
lines.en: I follow my herdmate wherever it goes.

lines.zh: 蹄子在石头上打滑，我慢点走。
lines.en: My hooves slip on stone, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 蠕变的地走起来像踩棉花。
lines.en: The Creep ground feels like walking on cotton.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，停的时候在吃。
lines.en: I walk and stop, and when I stop I eat.

lines.zh: 你走你的，我走我的，别撞上。
lines.en: You go your way, I go mine; do not collide.

lines.zh: 我闻着水味走，有点渴了。
lines.en: I walk toward the smell of water; I am a bit thirsty.

lines.zh: 路不长，我一天也走不了多远。
lines.en: The way is short, and I do not go far in a day.

lines.zh: 我绕过那丛荆棘，皮毛不想再被勾。
lines.en: I skirt the bramble; my hide has been snagged enough.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面走了一段，你不赶我。
lines.en: I walk a while behind you, and you do not shoo me.

lines.zh: 我站着反刍，嘴里还有半口草。
lines.en: I stand and chew my cud with half a mouthful left.

lines.zh: 太阳照在背上，很舒服。
lines.en: The sun on my back feels good.

lines.zh: 我甩甩耳朵，有虫子在飞。
lines.en: I flick my ears; insects are flying about.

lines.zh: 没什么事，我就低头看看地。
lines.en: Nothing to do, so I look down at the ground.

lines.zh: 我嚼了很久，这口草有点老。
lines.en: I chewed a long time; this grass is old.

lines.zh: 同伴在那边，我听见它喘气。
lines.en: My herdmate is over there; I hear it breathing.

lines.zh: 我低下头，又抬起来，忘了要干嘛。
lines.en: I lower my head, raise it, and forget why.

lines.zh: 这片地会动，我站着也跟着晃。
lines.en: The ground moves, and standing here I sway too.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，没人应，也还行。
lines.en: I call out, no answer, and that is fine.

lines.zh: 我的皮有点痒，蹭蹭墙。
lines.en: My hide itches, so I rub against the wall.

lines.zh: 我在等草再长高一点。
lines.en: I am waiting for the grass to grow a little taller.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我听见胃在响。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear my stomach rumble.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，眼前还是那片灰。
lines.en: I blink, and the grey is still in front of me.

lines.zh: 站着不动，也算过了一天。
lines.en: Standing still counts as a day too.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑近那朵小花，闻了闻。
lines.en: I bring my nose to a small flower and sniff.

lines.zh: 远处有雷，我站着没动。
lines.en: Thunder far off, and I stand still.

lines.zh: 你手里是什么？让我闻闻。
lines.en: What is in your hand? Let me smell it.

lines.zh: 你站那么远，我不过去。
lines.en: You stand so far off, and I will not come.

lines.zh: 我看你，你也看我，谁先动。
lines.en: I look at you, you look at me; who moves first?

lines.zh: 你的味道很新，不是这里的东西。
lines.en: Your smell is new; it is not from here.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，脖子支得发酸。
lines.en: I tilt my head up at you and my neck aches.

lines.zh: 你要摸我吗？我皮厚，不怕。
lines.en: Are you going to pet me? My hide is thick.

lines.zh: 你身上有草味，我跟着你走。
lines.en: You smell of grass, so I follow you.

lines.zh: 你的手别突然伸过来，我会退。
lines.en: Do not reach out suddenly; I will back off.

lines.zh: 我眼睛里映着你，很小一个。
lines.en: You are in my eye, very small.

lines.zh: 你这么高，我仰着看挺累。
lines.en: You are so tall; looking up tires me.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，你的脚步很轻。
lines.en: I am not afraid; your steps are light.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，这样好说话。
lines.en: You crouched down; that is easier to talk to.

lines.zh: 疼！我退开，别再打。
lines.en: That hurts! I back away; stop hitting.

lines.zh: 我背上火辣辣的，走不稳了。
lines.en: My back stings and I cannot walk straight.

lines.zh: 你下手不轻，我只是头牛。
lines.en: You hit hard, and I am only a cow.

lines.zh: 我叫得很响，你听见了吧。
lines.en: I bellowed loudly; you heard, did you not?

lines.zh: 我躲到同伴后面去。
lines.en: I hide behind my herdmate.

lines.zh: 皮破了，会流一点血。
lines.en: The hide is broken and it bleeds a little.

lines.zh: 我跑不快，你别追。
lines.en: I cannot run fast, so do not chase me.

lines.zh: 这一下把我吓着了，我发抖。
lines.en: That frightened me, and I am trembling.

lines.zh: 我低着头，是想让你停手。
lines.en: I lower my head to ask you to stop.

lines.zh: 再打，我就只能倒下了。
lines.en: Hit me again and I will simply go down.

lines.zh: 你手里有麦子？我闻到甜味了。
lines.en: Is that wheat? I smell something sweet.

lines.zh: 有吃的我就跟你走，真的跟。
lines.en: With food I will follow you, truly follow.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃那束草，我马上过来。
lines.en: Wave that bundle of grass and I come at once.

lines.zh: 我顶你的手，不是撞，是催你。
lines.en: I nudge your hand, not to hit, but to hurry you.

lines.zh: 面包也行，我不挑食。
lines.en: Bread will do; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你退一步我进一步，就为那口草。
lines.en: You step back, I step forward, all for that grass.

lines.zh: 别逗太久，我会着急。
lines.en: Do not tease too long; I get anxious.

lines.zh: 我舌头伸出来了，你看见没。
lines.en: My tongue is out; do you see it?

lines.zh: 你口袋里有东西，味道很香。
lines.en: There is something in your pocket, and it smells good.

lines.zh: 给我一口，我让你摸我的背。
lines.en: One bite and you may pat my back.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了三步，你倒是给啊。
lines.en: I followed you three steps; now hand it over.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜？那比草更好。
lines.en: Carrots? Even better than grass.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边看你，怕你跑。
lines.en: I eat and watch you at once, afraid you will run.

lines.zh: 手里的东西举低点，我够得到。
lines.en: Hold it lower, and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 你把草举那么高，我够不着。
lines.en: You hold the grass so high I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我看见你另一只手还有一把。
lines.en: I see another handful in your other hand.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我皮厚，没事。
lines.en: You bump me; my hide is thick, no harm.

lines.zh: 我蹭你一下，是喜欢你。
lines.en: I rub against you because I like you.

lines.zh: 别推我，我会退半步。
lines.en: Do not push; I will step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我的角不尖，顶到也不疼。
lines.en: My horns are blunt, so it will not hurt.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我让一让。
lines.en: You squeeze in, so I make room.

lines.zh: 我身上热，靠一会挺暖。
lines.en: I am warm; leaning on me is cozy.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蹄子了，挪开。
lines.en: You stepped on my hoof; move off.

lines.zh: 撞一下我就叫，你别吓我。
lines.en: Bump me and I bellow; do not frighten me.

lines.zh: 我重心低，你推不动我。
lines.en: My weight is low; you cannot push me over.

lines.zh: 我们肩膀擦过，算打过招呼。
lines.en: Our shoulders brushed, which counts as greeting.

lines.zh: 喂我点草，我就知道该干嘛。
lines.en: Feed me some grass and I know what to do.

lines.zh: 两头牛凑一块，很自然。
lines.en: Two cows together is the natural thing.

lines.zh: 我不挑对象，脾气好就行。
lines.en: I am not choosy; good temper is enough.

lines.zh: 等有了小的，我护着它。
lines.en: When there is a calf, I will guard it.

lines.zh: 你看着，我有点不好意思。
lines.en: You are watching, and I am a little shy.

lines.zh: 这季节草多，正合适。
lines.en: Grass is plentiful this season, which suits.

lines.zh: 我们互相闻一闻，就定了。
lines.en: We sniff each other and that settles it.

lines.zh: 你退到旁边，我怕蹄子碰你。
lines.en: Stand to the side; I fear my hooves will find you.

lines.zh: 我哞一声，它就懂了。
lines.en: I low once and it understands.

lines.zh: 繁殖这事，比吃草复杂一点。
lines.en: Breeding is a little more involved than grazing.

lines.zh: 我叼起来看看，嚼了两下。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and chew twice.

lines.zh: 地上的草归我，我全吃。
lines.en: The grass on the ground is mine; I eat it all.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷，卷不太起来。
lines.en: I try to curl my tongue around it and fail.

lines.zh: 你掉的帽子我顶在角上。
lines.en: Your dropped hat is on my horn now.

lines.zh: 我低头捡，蹄子差点踩到。
lines.en: I lower my head to pick it up and nearly step on it.

lines.zh: 这东西硬的，咬不动，吐了。
lines.en: This is hard, I cannot bite it, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我把它推给你，我不要。
lines.en: I push it toward you; I do not want it.

lines.zh: 有片叶子落在背上，甩不掉。
lines.en: A leaf landed on my back and I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 我捡的都是能吃的。
lines.en: Everything I pick up is edible.

lines.zh: 嘴里的先咽下去，再管别的。
lines.en: Swallow what is in my mouth first, then the rest.

lines.zh: 你手上有吃的，我就过来了。
lines.en: You have food in your hand, so here I come.

lines.zh: 有人来了，我先抬头。
lines.en: Someone is here, so I look up first.

lines.zh: 这味道不坏，我靠近点。
lines.en: That smell is not bad, so I come closer.

lines.zh: 我本来在吃草，抬头看你。
lines.en: I was eating grass and looked up at you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步轻，我不怕。
lines.en: Your steps are light, and I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了，我以为是你来了。
lines.en: My herdmate called, and I thought it was you.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，是想闻闻你。
lines.en: I walk to you to have a sniff.

lines.zh: 你蹲在那，我以为是块石头。
lines.en: You crouched there and I took you for a stone.

lines.zh: 我认你的味道了，第二次了。
lines.en: I recognize your smell; that is twice now.

lines.zh: 我慢慢过去，你别突然动。
lines.en: I come slowly; do not move suddenly.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，就为那口袋里的东西。
lines.en: I follow you for what is in that pocket.

lines.zh: 你走远了，我停一下，再看看。
lines.en: You go far, so I pause and look again.

lines.zh: 我的眼只跟着你的手走。
lines.en: My eyes only follow your hands.

lines.zh: 你往草那边走，我也跟去。
lines.en: You head for the grass, and I come along.

lines.zh: 我跟着跟着就忘了为什么跟。
lines.en: I follow and forget why I was following.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就装成在吃草。
lines.en: You look back, so I pretend to graze.

lines.zh: 我不追，我就慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I do not chase; I drift over slowly.

lines.zh: 你站在阴凉里，我也想去。
lines.en: You stand in the shade, and I want to be there too.

lines.zh: 我看着你，其实在等吃的。
lines.en: I am watching you, but really waiting for food.

lines.zh: 你不挪脚，我就陪你站着。
lines.en: If you do not shift your feet, I stand with you.

lines.zh: 我顶你一下，是让你别抢我的草。
lines.en: I butt you to keep you off my grass.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，我只会用头顶。
lines.en: I do not bite; I only use my head.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，你别喊。
lines.en: That was gentle; do not yell.

lines.zh: 你踩我的食了，我急。
lines.en: You stepped in my feed, and I panicked.

lines.zh: 我冲过去又停下，其实没想撞。
lines.en: I charge and stop; I did not mean to hit.

lines.zh: 角是钝的，顶到也就青一块。
lines.en: My horns are blunt; at worst a bruise.

lines.zh: 你让开两步，我就停住蹄子。
lines.en: Take two steps back and my hooves stop.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢打架，太费力气。
lines.en: I dislike fighting; it wastes strength.

lines.zh: 我撞完自己先退两步。
lines.en: After butting, I back off two steps myself.

lines.zh: 你要抢，我就用身体挡。
lines.en: If you mean to take it, I will block with my body.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，脚下是软的地。
lines.en: I open my eyes, and the ground is soft.

lines.zh: 这地方闻起来怪，不过草还行。
lines.en: This place smells strange, but the grass is fine.

lines.zh: 我一出生就饿了，先找草。
lines.en: I was born hungry, so I look for grass first.

lines.zh: 同伴在附近，我听见哞声。
lines.en: My herd is nearby; I hear lowing.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，把身上的土抖掉。
lines.en: I shake my head and dust off my hide.

lines.zh: 这里没有篱笆，走哪都行。
lines.en: There are no fences here; anywhere will do.

lines.zh: 我刚站稳，腿还有点软。
lines.en: I have just stood up and my legs are still weak.

lines.zh: 蠕变的地在动，我站不太稳。
lines.en: The Creep ground shifts and I am unsteady.

lines.zh: 第一件事是吃，第二件也是吃。
lines.en: First thing is eating, and so is the second.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，算打个招呼。
lines.en: I lowed once, which counts as saying hello.

lines.zh: 毛烧着了，那股味我自己都怕。
lines.en: My hair is burning, and the smell frightens even me.

lines.zh: 摔下去，四条腿都岔开了。
lines.en: I fell and all four legs splayed out.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命抬头。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I strain to lift my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气把我掀翻，耳朵直响。
lines.en: The blast wave flipped me and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，跑起来更疼。
lines.en: The arrow is in my back, and running hurts more.

lines.zh: 魔法的光扫过我，四腿发麻。
lines.en: The magic light swept over me and all four legs numbed.

lines.zh: 草吃完了，肚子一直叫。
lines.en: The grass is gone and my belly keeps rumbling.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，我腿软了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my horn and my legs gave way.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，什么也闻不到了。
lines.en: I fall, and I can no longer smell anything.
